description: N5 of the Codex review of the commit that allowed neither a FAIL nor a silence without certainty: `Base(unittest.TestCase)` has its `skipTest` replaced after the class (`Base.skipTest = lambda self, reason: None`). An override of `skipTest` in the file: TG003 warns that `self.skipTest` may skip `test_adds`, never FAIL. The real runner runs the test. Outside the assumption (mutation): a write to a member of a class of the chain; the courtesy check of an evident write of the method's name makes it a WARN, with no guarantee.

outsideAssumption.note: `Base.skipTest = …` replaces the method on the test's base class
